faqs.question: How much roof space do I need?
faqs.answer: Roughly 80–100 sq ft of shadow-free roof per kW. A 3 kW system needs about 240–300 sq ft. We confirm this during the free site survey.

faqs.question: How long does installation take?
faqs.answer: Most home systems are installed in 2–3 days. Net-meter installation by the DISCOM usually takes another 2–4 weeks.

faqs.question: Will solar work during the monsoon?
faqs.answer: Yes, at lower output. Panels still generate on cloudy days, and yearly production evens out across seasons.

faqs.question: Are the prices on your website final?
faqs.answer: No. They are estimates for a standard RCC roof. Final price depends on roof type, structure height, cable length, panel and inverter brand, and site conditions. You get a written quote after the survey.

faqs.question: Do you offer EMI or loans?
faqs.answer: We can connect you with banks that offer solar loans under the PM Surya Ghar scheme. Interest rates and approval depend on the bank.

faqs.question: How much subsidy can I get?
faqs.answer: Under PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana, homes get ₹30,000 per kW for the first 2 kW and ₹18,000 for the 3rd kW: ₹30,000 for 1 kW, ₹60,000 for 2 kW and a maximum of ₹78,000 for 3 kW or more (MNRE guidelines). Amounts and eligibility are set by the government and can change; check pmsuryaghar.gov.in for current rules.

faqs.question: What is the last date for PM Surya Ghar?
faqs.answer: The MNRE guidelines say the scheme will be implemented till 31 March 2027. No extension had been officially notified as of October 2026. Always confirm the current date on pmsuryaghar.gov.in or the national helpline 15555.

faqs.question: Who is eligible for the PM Surya Ghar subsidy?
faqs.answer: Households with a residential electricity connection from their DISCOM, installing a grid-connected rooftop system with made-in-India (DCR) panels through a vendor registered on the national portal. Non-residential connections are not eligible.

faqs.question: How do I apply for the subsidy?
faqs.answer: Register on pmsuryaghar.gov.in with your consumer number, choose a registered vendor, get the system installed, upload the details and photos, and after DISCOM inspection and net metering the subsidy is credited to your bank account through the portal.

faqs.question: Do shops and factories get subsidy?
faqs.answer: The residential subsidy does not apply to commercial or industrial connections. Businesses can often claim accelerated depreciation instead; ask your CA.

faqs.question: How often should panels be cleaned?
faqs.answer: In Raipur's dusty months, every 2–4 weeks. In the monsoon, rain does part of the job. Our AMC plans schedule this for you.

faqs.question: What is drone solar panel cleaning?
faqs.answer: A drone-assisted method of cleaning solar panels, useful for large rooftops, tall buildings, sheds and ground-mounted plants that are slow or risky to clean by hand. We share before/after photos and generation readings.

faqs.question: Is drone cleaning right for my home rooftop?
faqs.answer: Small home rooftops are often quicker to clean by hand. We check your site for free and recommend drone or manual cleaning based on array size, height and access.

faqs.question: What is the 6-month free care plan?
faqs.answer: Every new Baba Solars installation includes six months of free panel cleaning, performance checks and after-sales support. After six months you can continue with an AMC or book cleaning when needed.

faqs.question: Do you service systems installed by other companies?
faqs.answer: Yes. We clean, inspect and repair systems from any installer.

faqs.question: What warranties come with the system?
faqs.answer: Typically 25 years on panel performance, 5–10 years on the inverter from the manufacturer, and 5 years on our workmanship.

about.heroTitle: A Raipur team that installs and looks after rooftop solar
about.heroIntro: {businessName} began as a local electrical contractor. Today we design, install and maintain solar systems for families, shops, schools and factories across Chhattisgarh.
story: Raipur gets strong sun for most of the year, and electricity bills keep climbing. A well-built rooftop system pays for itself in four to six years and keeps working for twenty-five.

But we kept seeing systems that were badly sized, shaded by water tanks, never cleaned, or abandoned by the installer after the first fault. So we built a company that does both: careful installation and long-term care.
Our engineers and technicians are local, trained in electrical safety, and reachable on the same number for years.
about.missionText: Make clean, reliable solar power affordable for every home and business in Chhattisgarh, and keep it producing for its full life.
about.principlesIntro: Four things we hold ourselves to on every job.

principles.title: Size it honestly
principles.text: We size systems to your bills and roof, not to the biggest number we can sell. If 2 kW is enough, we say so.

principles.title: Show every rupee
principles.text: Quotes list panel and inverter brand, structure, cabling and labour separately, so you can compare.

principles.title: Build for 25 years
principles.text: Hot-dip galvanised structures, proper earthing and lightning arresters, and cable routing that survives the monsoon.

principles.title: Stay after handover
principles.text: Cleaning, inspection and repair are half our work. We service systems from any installer.
